_about: Public-domain Donald Sage Mackay (1863-1908), minister of the Collegiate Church of St Nicholas, New York, for the Word Hoard: The Religion of the Threshold and other sermons, a memorial sermon for Queen Victoria, and his 1904 sermon before the American Seamen's Friend Society. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 114 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dsmackay-victoria: In memoriam. Victoria, the woman; sermmon preached at the memorial service of Her Majesty Queen Victoria, at the Collegiate Church, Fifth Avenue and 48th Street ([New York, The Knickerbocker Press], 1901)
dsmackay-seamen: Annual sermon before the American Seamen's Friend Society at its seventy-sixth anniversary, Sunday, May 8, 1904 in the Collegiate Church / by Donald Sage Mackay (New York : American Seamen's Friend Society, 1904)
